title: Pashinyan Confronts the Karabakh Cause
gist: Reelected in June, Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan is pushing a peace deal with Azerbaijan under his 'Real Armenia' doctrine while his government scapegoats Karabakh refugees and prosecutes opponents, raising OSCE concerns about selective justice. His Civil Contract party fell just short of the majority needed to amend the constitution as Baku demands, creating a bottleneck for the peace accord.

themes.theme: Peace with Azerbaijan and its constitutional bottleneck

insights.claim: Pashinyan's 'Real Armenia' doctrine, unveiled Feb. 19, 2025, calls for focusing on the existing state within internationally recognized borders rather than 'historical' Armenia, and in August 2025 he and Azerbaijan's Ilham Aliyev signed a cessation-of-hostilities declaration at the White House, initialing a peace agreement.
